text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HaveTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Reptile(x) ::: x is a reptile.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Question: ::: Question about the classification of platypuses.

Premises:
Some mammals have teeth. ::: ∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x))
Platypuses have no teeth. ::: ¬∃x (Platypus(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x))
Platypuses are mammals. ::: ∀x (Platypus(x) → Mammal(x))
Humans have teeth. ::: ∀x (Human(x) → HaveTeeth(x))

Conclusion:
¬Reptile(platypus) ::: Platypuses are reptiles. (Question asks if this is true, so the statement being evaluated is whether platypuses are reptiles or not)
